torchbearer.idle: A person stands still, breathing cautiously, holding their right hand raised at shoulder height as if carrying a torch.
torchbearer.walk: A person walks forward carefully, keeping their right hand raised at shoulder height as if carrying a torch.
torchbearer.sprint: A person runs forward urgently, keeping their right hand raised as if carrying a torch.
torchbearer.crouch_idle: A person stays crouched and still, looking cautiously around, right hand held forward.
torchbearer.crouch_walk: A person walks slowly forward in a low crouch, right hand held forward.
torchbearer.interact: A standing person reaches forward with the left hand, takes a small object, then returns to standing.
torchbearer.relight: A person brings both hands together near their chest, strikes a match, then raises their right hand.
torchbearer.burst: A person briefly thrusts their raised right hand forward, recoils from a flash, then returns to standing.
torchbearer.death: A frightened person stumbles, falls to their knees, then collapses to the ground.

hunter.idle: A tall person stands hunched forward, arms hanging low, breathing slowly.
hunter.search: A person walks slowly forward with a hunched back and long hanging arms, pausing to look around.
hunter.pursue: A person runs forward aggressively, leaning forward with long swinging arms.
hunter.capture: A person lunges forward and reaches out with both hands, then stops.
hunter.banish: A person recoils backward, shielding their face with both arms, then crouches down.

stalker.idle: A hunched person stands very still and tilts their head as if listening.
stalker.investigate: A hunched person creeps forward carefully, stopping to listen.
stalker.recoil: A person recoils from a bright light, covers their face and steps backward.
